name: yt-x
summary: Browse YouTube and other yt-dlp supported sites from the terminal or your launcher, then play them in mpv
description: yt-x is a POSIX shell script that searches YouTube and other sites supported by yt-dlp, shows results with thumbnails through fzf or rofi, and plays or downloads your pick with mpv and yt-dlp. It supports subscriptions, playlists, trending, watch history, saved searches and a configurable theme, so you can watch videos without opening a browser.
